video_title: Nick Van Exel on a CRAZY story and missing a bus 😵

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on the significance of his NCAA tournament run
quotes.excerpt: My biggest dream was playing in the NCAA tournament.
quotes.quote: I played basketball a long time and like I say, my biggest dream was playing in the NCAA tournament. So that probably was my biggest individual accomplishment as a hooper, making it to the Final Four.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on the infamous bus incident in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: The bus don't ride by, because it's a light. The light right there, the bus just stopped.
quotes.quote: When y'all watch the Jail Blazers, the documentary, and Rashid and them was like, and the bus rode by, right? That shit was so crazy because look, we in Minnesota, dog. And Minnesota was off the chain at that time. We in Minnesota, I ain't gonna say my teammates' names, but it was three of us, right? We go into the little shop, they got the videos, the little nasty videos. That shit right? So, we come out, we on the corner, shot right there, the bus don't ride by, because it's a light. The light right there, the bus just stopped. So we, it's us three, right? We right here, and the bus right here, we looking like, man, like y'all come out the freak shop.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on the challenge of facing Michigan's Fab Five
quotes.excerpt: The history that they brought to the game is you can't match that.
quotes.quote: That Final Four, playing against Michigan and the Fab Five, that shit was dope because at the time, when you in it, you ain't thinking about the Fab Five. You like, man, fuck them, we going to go at these dudes. But the history that they brought to the game is you can't match that. Five freshmen, they come with the black socks, they got swag, baggy shorts, and they hooping.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on the pressure of cameras during draft workouts
quotes.excerpt: I'm looking at mock drafts. I'm moving up like I was at 39, I'm all the way at 28.
quotes.quote: What threw me off about the Final Four, I can't front, was just the cameras. There was so many cameras in that motherfucker. Every time I walked into like a shootaround, it do something to my mental. I'm looking at mock drafts. I'm moving up like I was at 39, I'm all the way at 28. That's how I'm thinking. When them cameras get in my face, I wait until I'm shooting last. I'm talking about the bus going to wait on me.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on his realization that he could play in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I never thought about the league until after that season and then in the summertime.
quotes.quote: I never thought about the league until after that season and then in the summertime. Motherfuckers you start seeing like the little magazines and shit. I'm like, damn, they talking about me. I'm on the cover of like the local joints when they the big sports joints. I never thought about the league, dog. When I was hooping the whole time, like JUCO to my junior year, I never thought about the league, not one time.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on his draft workout experience in Seattle
quotes.excerpt: I don't know George Karl is, man, but I didn't know George Karl went to North Carolina.
quotes.quote: I don't know George Karl is, man, but I didn't know George Karl went to North Carolina. You got an LA hat on, I got on, I had hats. I collect, I love wearing hats. And so I had on the Duke hat. I don't know George Karl. I don't know you went to North Carolina. I ain't know that. So I go to the workout in Seattle, and I'm working out, and y'all y'all remember, what's the coach that coached for the Bucks and Portland? Stotts. Stotts. Man, that motherfucker was wearing my ass out one-on-one, right? Now, I got I got all these workouts lined up.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on lying about a car accident to miss a workout
quotes.excerpt: I made up a bullshit lie. I told them I was in a car accident going to the airport.
quotes.quote: My flight leave for Charlotte like at 8:00. When I tell you we probably went to sleep at 7:00. So I I made up a bullshit lie. You know I was young. I told them I was in a car accident going to the airport. Going to the airport. I missed that workout, missed the whole workout. So, they bring me in the day of the draft. I probably hit every motherfucking jump shot at that workout. Everything was just I was just feeling it.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on getting the call from the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: The Lakers going to get you at 37. Jerry West is going to call you.
quotes.quote: My little cell flip phone ring. It's Tony, my my agent Tony Dutt, and he's like, the Lakers going to get you at 37. Jerry West is going to call you. I'm like, all right, I'm drunk than a motherfucker. I'm so motherfucker drunk. I ain't watching the draft. My little TV way over there. I ain't watching that motherfucker. Next thing you know, Jerry West call. He's like, how you doing? I said, man, I'm good, I'm good. He said, you know, we thinking about taking you with the 37 pick. How do you feel about that? I said, man, that's the happiest day of my life.

quotes.speaker: Nick Van Exel
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Van Exel on his draft night and path to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I came from a single parent home. I wasn't supposed to be here.
quotes.quote: They don't understand, me and Blunt went 20 something to the Bulls. I was supposed to go way before him, but he went 20 something to the Bulls and then I go 37 to the Lakers. They don't even know, man, that nigga we went out and had a great time that night, draft night. But they thinking I'm going to be mad. I'm like, y'all don't understand why I came from. I came from a single parent home. I wasn't supposed to be here. And I get drafted to the Lakers.
